name: Kasbah Detection Coverage Scorecard Corpus
description: Labeled corpus for detector-level precision/recall/F1 measurement. Two suites: secret-leak (packages/api-server/src/governance/secret-leak.js) and multilingual-pii (packages/api-server/src/systems/multilingual-pii.js). Positives are real-shaped credential/PII patterns (using vendor-documented example formats, never live secrets). Negatives include realistic false-positive traps drawn from things that have actually tripped these detectors before: example.com domains, git SHAs, UUIDs, order/invoice numbers, version strings, timestamps, and explicit placeholder/test markers.

labelSchema.secret-leak: expect_detect (boolean) - true if the text contains a real-shaped credential the detector should flag; category groups related cases
labelSchema.multilingual-pii: expect_detect (boolean) - true if the text contains a real-shaped PII value the detector should flag
